summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Atlas remote support app. 19/19 pytest tests passed covering all 12 seeded accounts, JWT auth, password change with revert, multi-operator isolation, Socket.IO session creation and reconnection with same token, ownership checks on tecnico:ver/clique, disconnect robustness, and REST CRUD on sessoes. Frontend UI login (correct + wrong password shows PT error), tab switching, session-link creation, and live client->tecnico session appearance verified via headless browser.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py disconnect handler correctly guards offline update by comparing sid == doc.sid (good, prevents stale-socket races).
webrtc:offer forwards to sess room using client's sid_sessao (fine); webrtc:answer/ice on tech side rely on sessaoId in payload and re-validate ownership on answer (good).
Minor: senha change endpoint does not invalidate previously issued JWTs (they remain valid until exp). Acceptable for internal tool but could be flagged for hardening.
Minor: CORS_ORIGINS='*' with allow_credentials=True is inconsistent (browsers reject); currently no cookie auth is used, so no functional impact.
seeding: upsert_utilizador correctly repõe password se .env mudar (verify_password check).
test_credentials.md is present with all 12 accounts and matches backend/.env exactly.
seed_data_creation: Sessões criadas via socket.io durante os testes foram limpas pelo próprio teste (limpar tudo / delete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py covers 19 tests including all 12 login params + full socket.io co-browsing flow. Uses BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Requires python-socketio + pytest-asyncio (already installed). WebRTC video is intentionally NOT tested (headless limitation) — only signaling events.
